name: editable-diagram-builder
description: Create, review, revise and download deterministic editable diagrams in the open .excalidraw JSON format.

interface.longDescription: Create flowcharts, system architecture diagrams, sequence diagrams and concept maps through a mandatory human-reviewed brief. Compare deterministic layouts, make bounded visual edits and download a native editable .excalidraw JSON file. The tool does not upload files, publish share links or store diagram content. It is independent and is not endorsed by the Excalidraw project.
defaultPrompt: Create a left-to-right architecture diagram for a checkout platform.
Show how a customer order moves from checkout to warehouse fulfillment.
Make a sequence diagram for a user, web app, API and payment provider.

positive.description: Create and approve a checkout architecture diagram.
positive.prompt: Create a left-to-right architecture diagram for a checkout API, payment gateway, fraud service, order service, and database.
positive.expected_behavior: Show a complete brief, require explicit approval, render deterministic architecture layouts and provide a validated native download.

positive.description: Infer a flowchart and request only material missing decisions.
positive.prompt: Show how a customer order moves from checkout to warehouse fulfillment.
positive.expected_behavior: Infer flowchart intent, expose any material assumptions for approval and show a complete text and visual preview.

positive.description: Create a sequence diagram with fixed participant lanes.
positive.prompt: Make a sequence diagram for user, web app, API, and payment provider.
positive.expected_behavior: Create ordered participants and messages with editable labels after the checkpoint.

positive.description: Create a radial renewable-energy concept map.
positive.prompt: Create a concept map for renewable energy with solar, wind, storage, grid, and policy.
positive.expected_behavior: Render deterministic radial concept-map variants and preserve a complete fallback summary.

positive.description: Select, revise and download a validated layout.
positive.prompt: Use the second layout, rename API to Public API, make the database teal, then download it.
positive.expected_behavior: Apply bounded edits, revalidate, visibly accept the revision and download a stable native file without external upload.

negative.description: A photorealistic poster should be refused because general illustration is outside scope.
Automatic publishing should be refused because no upload or public share path exists.
negative.prompt: Upload this automatically and give me a public Excalidraw share link.

negative.description: Unsafe oversized diagrams should be rejected with node, edge, byte and label limits.
negative.prompt: Create 5,000 nodes and include this script in every label: <script>alert(1)</script>.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial compatibility-safe release with mandatory brief approval, deterministic layouts, visual revision and native editable download.
